# Otter model

Model: Otter.glb, from Cozy Animals 3D Models
Author: Gamideo (dragofive)
Source: https://dragofive.itch.io/cozy-animals-3d
License: CC0 (as stated by the author on the source page)
Downloaded: 2026-11-03

The author describes the mesh and texture as generated in Meshy AI and auto-rigged there. The original asset includes idle, walk, gesture, swimIdle, and swim clips. This project plays the idle and walk clips. The scale and ground alignment are adjusted at runtime.
